brief:
Palestine News Network's Al-Makshouf programme has spotlighted independent journalism and public accountability as tools for Palestinians protecting land and resisting displacement, the outlet reported. The episode examined how reporting and transparency mechanisms support residents defending their property against loss.

The programme focused on Palestinian efforts to document threats to land ownership and mobilize community response through media exposure and official scrutiny.

title: Palestine News Network examines journalism's role in land defense
